page: Google Cloud Platform a3-ultragpu-8g-nolssd is an accelerator-optimized server designed for high-density compute and massive parallel processing. It features 224 vCPUs powered by Intel Xeon 8581C processors with an x86_64 architecture, operating at 2.1 GHz across 112 physical cores. The system is equipped with 2952.0 GB of system memory, providing 13.18 GB per core. Acceleration is driven by eight NVIDIA Hopper H200 GPUs, delivering a combined 1123 GB of VRAM. This configuration does not include local SSD storage.

Benchmark data indicates top-tier multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng multi-core and Passmark CPU scores ranking in the top 10%. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, achieving top-tier status in both read-only and write operations for large blocks. Cryptographic and vector operations benefit from hardware-accelerated instruction sets, including AVX-512 and Intel Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX). Multi-threaded decompression and Redis SET operations also register in the top 10% of performance benchmarks.

Given its massive resource density and premium accelerator hardware, this server represents a high-tier investment tailored for workloads that can fully utilize eight H200 GPUs and nearly 3 TB of RAM. The primary tradeoff is the complete absence of local SSD storage, meaning all persistent storage must be attached network storage, which may impact I/O-heavy local operations.

This server is optimized for large-scale artificial intelligence and machine learning workloads, including large language model (LLM) training and inference, high-performance computing (HPC), massive parallel simulations, and data science pipelines requiring extensive GPU acceleration and substantial system memory.
